screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
screwdriver.shortDescription: While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Screws.
screwdriver.flavorText: The humble screwdriver, a common fixture of the spare drawers of citizens in the Upper and Lower Levels alike.

welder.name: Plasma Cutter
welder.shortDescription: Can be used to salvage Scrap Metal by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Scrap Metal.
welder.flavorText: High frequency ignition plasma cutter. Manufactured for guaranteed stability, and a fast, strong and smooth cut.

wire_cutter.name: Wire Cutter
wire_cutter.shortDescription: Can be used to salvage Wire by disassembling broken machines. While carrying this, scavenging in the Dumping Grounds yields 10% more Wire.
wire_cutter.flavorText: Spring action ensures good leverage and reduces strain on the user, while the soft rubber handles give good grip and comfort.

toolbox.name: Toolbox
toolbox.shortDescription: Holds tools. Press 1-9 on the keyboard to equip the stored item.

labeler.name: Labeler
labeler.shortDescription: Used to edit the label of an item.

intake_hopper.name: Intake Hopper
intake_hopper.shortDescription: Can be linked to an Outlet Hopper and configured to send the items of its inventory into the Outlet Hopper's inventory every night. Use it on an Outlet Hopper to link them, double-click to set it up.

outlet_hopper.name: Outlet Hopper
outlet_hopper.shortDescription: Receives the items sent by its linked Intake Hoppers into its inventory every night. Use it on an Intake Hopper to link them, double-click to run them now.

magnifier.name: Magnifying Glass
magnifier.shortDescription: Used to inspect certain items more closely.

turbo_booster.name: Disposable Turbo Booster
turbo_booster.shortDescription: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Consumed upon use.

turbo_booster_adv.name: Advanced Turbo Booster
turbo_booster_adv.shortDescription: A tool that can immediately power machines that require time to operate. Ensure the target machine has all the necessary inputs before using. Recharges over time. This advanced version will not be consumed upon use.

turbo_booster_hypertech.name: Hypertech Turbo Booster
turbo_booster_hypertech.shortDescription: A turbo booster powered by an Energy Cell. It charges every cycle and banks spare charge. Once charged, it instantly completes a machine's current cycle.

mind_reprogrammer.name: Mind Reprogrammer
mind_reprogrammer.shortDescription: Can remove and add certain perks. Consume Electronic Parts (Hypertech) to charge it. The device needs time to reset after each use.

sign_water.name: Water Neon Sign
sign_water.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Water

sign_food.name: Food Neon Sign
sign_food.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Food

sign_medical.name: Medical Neon Sign
sign_medical.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Medical

sign_household.name: Household Item Neon Sign
sign_household.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Household Good

sign_material.name: Material Neon Sign
sign_material.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Material

sign_ruined_machine.name: Scrap Machine Sign
sign_ruined_machine.shortDescription: Put it in the display case to attract scrappers that sell Ruined Machines.

sign_firearm.name: Firearm Neon Sign
sign_firearm.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Firearm

sign_firearm_heavy.name: Heavy Firearm Neon Sign
sign_firearm_heavy.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract customer that will sell Firearm

xray_scanner.name: Portable XRay Scanner
xray_scanner.shortDescription: Can be use to see what's inside sealed containers.

sign_expedition.name: Expedition Sign
sign_expedition.shortDescription: Place it in the display case to attract new hirelings for hire and current hirelings ready for expedition.
